summary.overview: PRVMTH01 is a month-end batch job that identifies Medicaid providers overdue for revalidation per federal 42 CFR 455.414 requirements, extracts active provider data for monthly CMS T-MSIS federal reporting, and archives the T-MSIS submission file to tape for long-term compliance retention.
business_functions: STEP010 - Scan the Provider Master File to identify all active providers whose revalidation due date has passed, queue them for re-screening with action 'RESCREEN-REQUIRED', and report the total count of providers flagged for revalidation in compliance with the 5-year federal revalidation cycle (42 CFR 455.414)
STEP010 - Write each overdue active provider's NPI and revalidation due date to a date-stamped Revalidation Queue file for downstream revalidation processing
STEP020 - Read the Provider Master File and extract all active Medicaid providers, validating enrollment dates to detect potential future-dated data quality issues

STEP020 - Format each active provider's Medicaid ID, NPI, active status, and current reporting period into the CMS T-MSIS compliant layout and write records to a date-stamped T-MSIS Provider Submission file for federal Medicaid reporting
STEP020 - Report the total number of provider records written to the T-MSIS submission file upon completion of the monthly extract

STEP030 - Archive the T-MSIS Provider Submission file produced in STEP020 to a tape-based Generation Data Group (GDG), creating a new versioned generation to ensure permanent retention of every monthly T-MSIS extract for audit and compliance purposes

PRVMTH01.jcl.program_overview: Scans the Provider Master File to identify active providers overdue for revalidation and writes them to the Revalidation Queue file
Extracts active Medicaid providers from the Provider Master File and formats them into the monthly CMS T-MSIS Provider Submission file
Archives the T-MSIS Provider Submission file to a tape-based GDG for long-term compliance retention

datasource_summary.name: Provider Master File (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS)
datasource_summary.function: The central provider master reference file containing all provider records. It is read sequentially to identify active providers for revalidation screening and to extract active provider data for T-MSIS submission to CMS.

datasource_summary.name: Revalidation Queue File (MMPRV.REVAL.QUEUE.D&DATE)
datasource_summary.function: A date-stamped output file that captures all provider records identified as requiring revalidation rescreening. Each record includes the provider NPI, revalidation due date, and an action code of 'RESCREEN-REQUIRED', serving as the queue for downstream revalidation processing.

datasource_summary.name: T-MSIS Provider Extract File (MMPRV.TMSIS.PROVIDER.D&DATE)
datasource_summary.function: A date-stamped file that holds formatted T-MSIS provider detail records (PRV01) containing Medicaid ID, NPI, active status, and reporting period. It is produced by the T-MSIS extraction process and subsequently read for archiving to CMS.

datasource_summary.name: T-MSIS Provider Archive (MMPRV.TMSIS.ARCHIVE(+1))
datasource_summary.function: A generational data group stored on tape that serves as the permanent archive copy of the T-MSIS provider extract. A new generation is created each time the monthly job runs, preserving a historical record of all T-MSIS provider submissions made to CMS.

datasource_summary.name: Production Load Library (MMPRV.PROD.LOADLIB)
datasource_summary.function: The production library containing the executable program modules used by the monthly provider processing job. It provides the compiled programs required to run the revalidation screening and T-MSIS extraction processes.
